messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@retailco.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RetailCo marketplace seller intake - capability & security sections

Hi Karthik and Laura,

Thanks for taking the time to engage on the RetailCo marketplace listing. Our vendor intake team has a two-page capability section and a security/operational compliance appendix we need completed before we move to legal. I've attached the questionnaire (XLSX) — key asks: tenant isolation guarantees, billing flow for marketplace purchases, expected latency/backpressure handling for inference calls, and SOC2 evidence.

Can you return the completed sheet by EOD Tuesday, and attach any high-level security docs (SOC2 summary, network isolation diagram)? If you have a standard marketplace manifest or a short 1‑page capabilities PDF, please include that as well.

Primary contact for Clarifications: Jane Morales (cc'd on follow-ups).

Thanks,
Procurement Team
RetailCo

Attachment: retailco_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: procurement@retailco.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rachel_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-19T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo marketplace seller intake - capability & security sections

Jane / RetailCo Procurement —

Appreciate the clear list. We've started filling the XLSX and attached a working draft that addresses each row; highlights below:

- Tenant isolation: Redwood supports strict VPC and dedicated-capacity options. For marketplace listings we typically show Shared-hosted (multi-tenant) + Dedicated (reserved) deployment modes. Dedicated customers can require VPC peering and customer-managed keys.
- Billing flow: marketplace purchases can be routed via the reseller flow (RetailCo billing) or direct invoiced usage depending on the marketplace. We attach a short billing diagram in the PDF.
- Latency & throttling: production SLAs are configurable per-route; typical 95th perc latency for text generation (gpt-style open models) is sub-250ms for short prompts on Dedicated pools. We include unit-cost guidance and autoscale behavior.
- SOC2: attaching a one-page SOC2 summary and evidence index; full reports available under NDA.

We attached: redwood_catalog_capabilities.pdf, retailco_questionnaire_answers.xlsx (draft), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf.

We can jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through any rows that need expansion. Laura / Rachel — can you review the answers in the spreadsheet and flag anything we should escalate to Security/Compliance before we send the finalized copy?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_catalog_capabilities.pdf; retailco_questionnaire_answers.xlsx; redwood_soc2_summary.pdf

From: Jane Morales <jane.morales@retailco.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-marketplace+onboard@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RetailCo marketplace seller intake - capability & security sections

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our security intake:

1) For multi-tenant hosting, do you provide logical tenant isolation at the network and process level, or is it purely application level? We need a short statement we can include in our vendor risk register.
2) Are there any customer data residency/region-locking options? We have buyers in EU and CA who require data to remain in-region.
3) For SOC2, can you confirm the date of the most recent assessment and whether coverage includes change management and incident response?

Also looping in AWS onboarding to confirm any marketplace-specific packaging requirements (license vs SaaS metering).

Would you be able to provide a one‑page bullet summary for each of the three points above by EOD today? Our legal team will use those to draft commercial language.

Cheers,
Jane Morales
Vendor Intake Lead — RetailCo
